[2026-08-19] event | Content creator event: 5,000 W Coin for a video
Are you a content creator, or interested in making videos for S.U.N Reborn? For a limited time, approved creators earn 5,000 W Coin for a qualifying video.

How to take part

Record and upload a S.U.N Reborn gameplay video to YouTube. To qualify it has to meet all of the following:

- The video is publicly available on YouTube
- It features actual S.U.N Reborn gameplay, clearly recorded and in good quality
- It is properly edited and enjoyable to watch
- Any music is copyright-free and safe for YouTube
- It clearly advertises or promotes the server, naming it as S.U.N Reborn -- Soul of the Ultimate Nation Reborn
- It tells viewers how to find and join the server
- It shows the game in a positive and engaging light

Low-effort, misleading, copied or spam-style videos do not qualify.

Ideas for your video

- General gameplay
- Character progression
- Dungeons and boss fights
- PvP
- Class showcases
- Beginner guides
- Server reviews and first impressions
- Group gameplay
- Funny or exciting moments

Be creative. We want content that makes people want to check out S.U.N Reborn.

Claiming your reward

Once the video is public, send the YouTube link to the staff in #support on Discord. We review it against the requirements above, and once it is approved 5,000 W Coin go to your account.

Rewards are issued for qualifying content only. Staff reserve the right to reject videos that do not meet the quality or promotional requirements of the event.

Help us spread the word and grow the S.U.N Reborn community.

[2026-08-01] announcement | Welcome to SUN Reborn
SUN Reborn is a progressive Soul of the Ultimate Nation server. You start at level one, the cap is sixty, and the rates are the ones the game was designed around.

The cash shop is priced at zero across the board and every account carries the premium flag. There is nothing to buy, so there is nothing to lose by playing for free -- because free is the only tier there is.
